name: sa-rett
description: Saudi Arabia real estate transaction tax for 2026 under the law effective 10 April 2025: identify the actual property/right/share transfer, fair-market-value basis, liable transferor, exemptions and first-home state-bearing support. Covers long usufruct, property-rich entities, gifts/inheritance, qualifying finance and restructuring boundaries, registration, payment, records and current penalties. Preserves the original March and July 2025 sales, Mr Al-Otaibi inheritance/onward sale and first-home illustration with their dates and conditions. Read before a Saudi RETT calculation or declaration.
